# 🚀 AntiCrasher v2.0.8
This is a small update, doing the following:
- Bumped PacketEvents to 2.9.5 (bug fixes)
- Added `<player_uuid>` placeholder.

Download here - [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/plugin/anticrasher)

## What's Changed
* Chore(deps): Bump com.gradleup.shadow:shadow-gradle-plugin from 9.0.0-rc1 to 9.0.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/smashyalts/AntiCrasher/pull/60
* Chore(deps): Bump adventure-version from 4.23.0 to 4.24.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/smashyalts/AntiCrasher/pull/55
* Chore(deps): Bump org.incendo:cloud-paper from 2.0.0-beta.10 to 2.0.0-beta.11 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/smashyalts/AntiCrasher/pull/50
* Chore(deps): Bump org.incendo:cloud-velocity from 2.0.0-beta.10 to 2.0.0-beta.11 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/smashyalts/AntiCrasher/pull/48
* Chore(deps): Bump org.jetbrains.gradle.plugin.idea-ext from 1.1.10 to 1.3 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/smashyalts/AntiCrasher/pull/61
* feat: v2.0.8 by @Skullians in https://github.com/smashyalts/AntiCrasher/pull/68


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/smashyalts/AntiCrasher/compare/2.0.7...2.0.8

# 🚀 AntiCrasher v2.0.7
This is a small update, doing the following:
- Added 1.21.8 support to all platforms.
- Bumped PacketEvents to 2.9.4 to support 1.21.7+.

Download here - [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/plugin/anticrasher)

## What's Changed
* Chore(deps): Bump de.exlll:configlib-yaml from 4.6.0 to 4.6.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/smashyalts/AntiCrasher/pull/36
* Chore(deps): Bump dev.kikugie.stonecutter from 0.6 to 0.6.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/smashyalts/AntiCrasher/pull/41
* Chore(deps): Bump com.gradleup.shadow:shadow-gradle-plugin from 9.0.0-beta15 to 9.0.0-beta17 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/smashyalts/AntiCrasher/pull/45
* Chore(deps): Bump org.projectlombok:lombok from 1.18.36 to 1.18.38 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/smashyalts/AntiCrasher/pull/40
* Chore(deps): Bump me.lucko:fabric-permissions-api from 0.3.3 to 0.4.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/smashyalts/AntiCrasher/pull/46
* Chore(deps): Bump adventure-version from 4.21.0 to 4.23.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/smashyalts/AntiCrasher/pull/44
* 1.21.6 Fabric & 1.21.7 support for Bukkit/Velocity by @Skullians in https://github.com/smashyalts/AntiCrasher/pull/47
* Feat: bump versions & 1.21.8 fabric support by @Skullians in https://github.com/smashyalts/AntiCrasher/pull/57


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/smashyalts/AntiCrasher/compare/2.0.5...2.0.7
